items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Jonesy used to -- his valet, he used to watch after him, too.

ctx.x: He had a bodyguard named "Weak Knees"?
"Weak Knees." Yeah, in Washington, D.C. But Jonesy -- Jonesy used to -- his valet, he used to watch after him, too.

At one time he had me -- he tricked me into having a breakfast with him because he thought -- he didn't tell me until after -- he thought this guy was going to come in the restaurant and beat him (up) and so I was supposed to be the bodyguard.
